item.title: Met Gala 2026: The 10 Best Musician Looks on the Red Carpet
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, your inside scoop on the latest in music and fashion. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the 2026 Met Gala. The stars have walked the carpet, and we're breaking down the top looks from the biggest night in fashion.
[Short music transition]
Host: "This year's Met Gala was all about the intersection of fashion and art, with co-chairs Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams, Anna Wintour, and the one and only Beyoncé, who made her first appearance in 10 years. The theme, 'Fashion Is Art,' left room for interpretation, and boy, did the stars interpret. From color to texture, references, and inspiration, no two looks were the same.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Billboard's got the scoop on the top 10 looks from musicians that stole the show. Think SZA's upcycled couture, Bad Bunny's... interesting senior citizen cosplay, and Beyoncé's grand return to the Met Gala. We're talking show-stopping, red carpet-worthy looks that are worth writing home about.
[Outro music starts]
Host: "Want to see the full list of Billboard's top Met Gala looks? Check out our website for the inside scoop. That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. Until next time, stay fashionable and keep on trending!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
